name: Game End Upgrades
placementTarget: Carrier sheet for the five Permanent Shelter stickers. The sheet itself is not placed on the board.
summary: Game End Upgrades, printed code P3-29a. Five Permanent Shelter icons, each with an orange 2. Put a Permanent Shelter sticker next to a city that had a shelter in the game just played. During setup, add a shelter to each city with a Permanent Shelter sticker.

mechanics.timing: Read at game end, when placing Permanent Shelters, and again during setup of later games.
mechanics.effect: Explains the five Permanent Shelter stickers. Each costs 2. Place one next to a city that had a shelter in the game just played. In later setup, put a shelter figure in every city that has the sticker.
restrictions: The sticker records a shelter from the game just finished.
Five icons, matching the five Permanent Shelter stickers.
This sheet does not list Rebirth. Rebirth is sticker-01.
